facts.name: Jennifer K. Griffin
facts.assignment: Suwannee County Court including county civil/small claims; acting circuit responsibilities include family/DV, juvenile delinquency, mental health, guardianship and probate, as listed on profile.

checklist.summary: Email the assistant with case number/name and matter in the subject; copy other parties unless an ex parte communication is legally authorized.

Coordinate by assistant email with opposing parties copied; promptly file/serve the hearing notice. For covered motions, hearing requests must verify the required conferral certificate or the stated pro-se exception; retain the linked exemptions.

Provide PDF and Word versions with a cover letter stating agreement or specific disagreements. Submit by email with other parties copied, or on paper using the guide’s service form; paper submissions include appropriate stamped envelopes. Due within ten days after hearing unless otherwise directed.

Hearing materials are due three business days before hearing. Email a Word case-citation list for evidentiary proceedings at least72hours ahead. Paper-copy threshold is stated inconsistently as50pages or more versus exceeding50; both source statements retained.
Guide describes hybrid appearances under rule2.530; obtain Zoom credentials from assistant. Requests to attend in person when noticed for Zoom are due by the preceding Friday.

facts.summary: Individual practical civil-office procedures and current contacts reviewed.
facts.review_scope: Seven-page original retained; contacts and recurring office sectionsA–E reviewed. Conferral sheet read for hearing-request requirement and exemptions. No motion-specific litigation recipes, evidentiary/trial packet analysis or exhaustive noncivil review.
conflicts: Guide page5 requires a paper copy for a motion50pages or more including attachments, then describes the threshold as exceeding50pages. No controlling interpretation selected.
gaps: No personal judge email published; listed mailbox is assistant contact.
